description: The signer fingerprint of a keyless project and how a consumer checks one. Every case has a `kind`. `derive`: the pin for an `issuer` and a `repository_id`, as the certificate records them; `expect` is the pin, or null when the inputs have no fingerprint (a missing or non-decimal repository ID). `parse`: whether the text in `pin` is a fingerprint at all; `expect` is `valid` or `invalid`, and only the one canonical spelling is valid. `check`: a `pin` against the certificate of a release that already verified, which carries an `issuer` and a `repository_id` (null when the certificate records none); `expect` is `match`, `mismatch` for another repository or issuer, or `no-repository-id` when the certificate gives nothing to compare. A `check` case names the `project` and `owner` the certificate was issued under only to show that neither is consulted.

cases.name: a repository ID that needs 63 bits
the same ID under another issuer is another pin
an owner's ID is not a repository's
any other issuer URL is hashed as given
a certificate without a repository ID has no fingerprint
cases.reason: Such a project needs an explicit identity and issuer instead.

cases.name: an ID that is not decimal has none
another version's prefix
cases.reason: A consumer that does not know a version cannot tell what it commits to.

cases.name: uppercase
cases.reason: Lowercase only, so a pin has one spelling.

cases.name: a character outside the base32 alphabet
a hex digit run, right length, wrong alphabet
leftover bits set in the last character
cases.reason: 26 characters carry 130 bits and the pin is 128; the last two must be zero or two spellings would name one pin.

cases.name: after a rename
cases.reason: The name is not part of the pin.

cases.name: after a transfer to another owner
cases.reason: The owner is not part of the pin, and Forge identity has a consumer follow a transfer.

cases.name: a name recreated by someone else
the same ID from another forge
a certificate from before IDs were recorded
cases.reason: Nothing to compare is not a match.
